facts.text: The user asked to put a list of themes into a table with three columns: Theme, Sector, and Description.
The user said the header for each separate list is a Sector.
The user said the Description column should be left blank initially.
The user provided multiple theme lists under the sectors Retail and Consumer, Real Estate, Energy / Utilities, and Financial Services.
The user asked to fill the first column with the relevant sector.
The user clarified that the whole column should be filled so every cell has a Sector.
The user said the Description column should be completed with a description of each theme.
The user specified that the themes are ESG-related themes.
